scopeNotes: New text needs independent review; earlier hashes do not certify it.
Map endpoints are not historical founding or extinction dates.

Both imported entries refer to the same islands in discontinuous historical snapshots: 1715 to 1783, and 1815 onward with later gaps. Their shared narrative is not a claim that an independent state existed throughout the colonial period.

Precolonial material evidence is separated from later states. Indian Creek pottery labels are not equated with exact ethnic, linguistic or national identities. Planned 2013 excavations in the undated project page are not asserted completed.

Burton’s Field shell ranges are reported in the 2017 paper as 3232 to 3367 and 2153 to 2310 calibrated years before 1950. Rounded endpoints correspond to approximately 1400 to 200 BCE. The broad phase is not continuous occupation established for every year or every site.

Stone sourcing is a morphological attribution, not an exact geochemical demonstration. Use-wear was obscured by alteration; no task is invented for individual flakes. Shell assemblages at the named sites do not constitute a complete census of the population’s diet.

The Betty’s Hope museum description and provisioning chapter abstract were consulted through indexed text. Neither the full chapter nor the original estate letters were inspected. Conflicting claims about the plantation’s founding are omitted.

Dockyard heritage recognizes the skills of enslaved workers while keeping coercion and imperial economic purposes explicit. Existing architecture is distinguished from a claim that every feature is an untouched eighteenth-century original.

The 2017 museum newsletter reprints a 1993 Cultural Division account and a 1996 Selvyn Walter recollection. Historical festival and salt practices are not presented as a current event schedule. The salt article’s nutritional claims are not reproduced.

Government historical material contains outdated population and political details; only the identified historical passages are used. No assessment of present land litigation or unresolved development disputes is inferred.

Independence and the constitutional provisions are documented separately from the imported coverage. The 1967 association is not described as full independence. No unverified successor link substitutes a present-day record for missing 1981 geometry.
The art source is the 2024 exhibition’s published description, not a claim to have viewed its recordings or personally inspected the archive.
Independent historical review, geometry assessment and depth certification remain pending.
